content: Human-labeling session — econ-protect-harvester-route:medium seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a supply-line protection drill with a tighter revenue bar. You hold a Construction Yard (fact), Ore Refinery (proc) and Power Plant (powr) at your west base, one harvester (harv, an unarmed ore-collector truck) commuting to a far ore patch about 50 cells east, and two medium tanks (2tnk) at the base on Defend stance. An enemy heavy tank (2tnk) targets the harvester and intercepts mid-route, beyond your base sight. Within about 60 turns, reach economy value $1200, keep the harvester alive, and keep your Construction Yard and Refinery standing.
